sentences.en: To my knowledge, this chemical will prevent germs from breeding.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，这种化学物质可以防止细菌繁殖。

sentences.en: My father has a ranch and breeds cattle and horses.
sentences.zh: 我父亲有一个牧场，并饲养牛和马。

sentences.en: In the countryside, everybody used to breed chicken and rabbits.
sentences.zh: 在农村，以前家家户户都养鸡兔。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：这一窝（brood）小鸡是同一个品种（breed）
